 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Houston Texans RB David Montgomery (groin) fully participated in practice Wednesday, Nov. 18, and is not on the injury report for Week 11.
 SOURCE: HoustonTexans.com 
 Why It Matters: Montgomery is set to return to the lineup this week and should see most of the work at running back with Woody Marks unavailable. He can be considered a No. 3 running back or flex option in fantasy leagues.
